primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-lqf-f-shriek-separated-colimits (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 977-991

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: f_! is left exact by construction and right exactness may be checked on stalks by the exactness theorem, so it suffices to compute stalks; the fibre over a geometric point is discrete by the locally quasi-finite fibres lemma with residue fields equal to k, so the geometric points of X over the given point are exactly the points of the fibre, and the stalk formula follows from the general stalk lemma for separated morphisms (source lines 993-1010)
